supersedes: pintle_dynamics_v2 (MECH v2.2 PTFE-guide drive, superseded by the lead 2026-10-12/13)

baseline_cfg.name: v2.3 baseline: MGN09H + plain DU pins

assumed.thrust: quasi-steady map, no chamber/fuel lag (Combustion owns the tail-off)

requirements.ENG-05: < 10 % F_max (50 N) within 0.10 s of the shutdown command

cross_check_vs_mech_v2p4.note: independent re-implementation of the MECH v2.3 equations; deviations are rounding of the published values

steps.case: nominal: spring 0, MECH baseline friction, rail typ
guide mu 0.02 + S 5 N (MECH sens.), spring +10 %, rail min
r 3.5 mm fallback, spring +10 %, rail min

noprog_normal_max_s.source: lost motion at the opening from the closed command (dog crosses 5 deg before the crank moves)

ground_unlit_N2_full_stroke_3p5MPa.note: cold-flow procedure case; the tracking timeout runs on the error > kPintleStallErr_m

acceptance.rule: measured unpowered back-drive torque at the HV69 output (slow, and at ~2 rad/s), every crank angle over the full stroke, <= 0.5 x the -10 % spring closing assist at that angle (column T_bd_allow_Nm, the minimum of bench and L0 at 3.5 / 5.5 / 7.0 MPa); scalar target <= 0.05 N m kept from v2
acceptance.unpowered_close_rule: unpowered spring closing 4.0 mm -> seated (servo unpowered, bench, nominal spring) within kPintleUnpoweredClose_s / 3 = SAFE-check margin 3 (config.h static_assert)

bpnt1_backdrive.tag: DERIVED from the MECH v2.3 model (L0, -10 % spring); the back-drive torque itself is UNKNOWN (B-PNT-1)
